notes:
Fix repeated Claude sign-in requests in Claw Bot.

DroidFun App 0.10.9 lets installed Claude Code renew an expired session on a normal installation, uses startup options compatible with older and current clients, and refreshes the connection status shown in account settings. It sends no model prompt and preserves saved screens, droid profiles and firmware. A revoked or unrefreshable Claude login can still require sign-in.

Includes universal Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows x64, Windows ARM64 and Linux installers. The Mac build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple Developer ID signed or notarized; macOS may show a first-install warning or block opening. Mac and Windows updates retain their cryptographically verified updater signatures. The shared updater feed supports earlier Mac and Windows clients, while Windows 0.10.8 and newer retain their independent update channel.

Validation details are recorded with the native package artifacts. Expiry/recovery checks use isolated fixture credentials; a new natural live-account expiry was not observed. The Mac package records its application and packaging-tool source commits separately.
